BiblicalUsage: Pimah means obesity, fatness of face. Eliphaz uses it once, in Job 15:27, for the wicked man who covers his face with his fatness and makes collops of fat on his flanks.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe prosperity on a wicked man is only fattening for the fall.
